Abashoramari 10 baturuka mu bihugu umunani bya Afurika bazahatanira inkunga ingana na miliyoni 1.5 z’amadolari ya Amerika mu irushanwa rizasorezwa i Kigali tariki ya 1 n’iya 2 Ukuboza 2026.

Africa’s Business Heroes (ABH), gahunda yo gushyigikira ba rwiyemezamirimo yashinzwe na Alibaba Philanthropy na Jack Ma Foundation, yatangaje ba rwiyemezamirimo 10 bageze mu cyiciro cya nyuma cy’irushanwa ryo mu 2026, bakazahurira i Kigali mu Rwanda, tariki ya 1 n’iya 2 Ukuboza 2026, bahatanira kugabana inkunga ingana na miliyoni 1.5 z’amadolari ya Amerika.

Aba ba rwiyemezamirimo 10 batoranyijwe mu busabe burenga 24,000 bwatanzwe n’abashoramari baturutse mu bihugu 54 bigize umugabane wa Afurika.

Babonye amahirwe yo kugera muri iki cyiciro nyuma yo kwitwara neza mu irushanwa ryabereye i Nairobi muri Kenya, tariki ya 21 n’iya 22 Kanama 2026, aho abantu 20 bari bageze muri kimwe cya kabiri cy’irushanwa bamurikiye akanama nkemurampaka ibikorwa byabo by'ubucuruzi. Ishusho ya ba rwiyemezamirimo bahanga udushya muri Afurika Aba 10 bageze mu cyiciro cya nyuma bagaragaza ishusho y’abashoramari bari kugira uruhare mu iterambere ry’ubukungu bwa Afurika.

Benshi mu bashoramari bakora ibikorwa byabo mu cyaro cyangwa hafi yacyo, kugira ngo begere abaturage n’amasoko bageneraga serivisi n’ibicuruzwa byabo.

Ubuhinzi n’ubuvuzi buri mu nzego zihagarariwe cyane, buri imwe ikaba ifite 30% by’abageze muri iki cyiciro. Ibi bigaragaza ko hibandwa ku guteza imbere ubuhinzi n’umusaruro wabwo, ndetse no korohereza abaturage kubona serivisi z’ubuvuzi.

Abagore bagize 40% by’abageze mu 10 ba mbere, mu gihe impuzandengo y’imyaka y’abashinze ibi bigo ari 35.

Aba ba rwiyemezamirimo bakomoka mu bihugu umunani ari byo Misiri, Kenya, Ethiopia, Nigeria, Afurika y’Epfo, Tanzania, Benin na Côte d’Ivoire.

Bakora mu nzego zitandukanye zirimo ubuhinzi, ubuvuzi, inganda, ikoranabuhanga ryifashishwa mu bucuruzi n’uburezi.

Akanama nkemurampaka kasuzumye ubushobozi bw’ibigo byabo, imiyoborere, udushya, uruhare mu iterambere, amahirwe yo gukura ndetse n’ubushobozi bwo kwagura ibikorwa.

Abagera muri 10 ba mbere muri Africa’s Business Heroes 2026 1. Salma Tammam – REME-D Company for Laboratory Equipment and Chemicals | Misiri | Ubuvuzi. 2. Ahmed Shaaban – Simplex for Software Development and Industrial Solutions | Misiri | Inganda. 3. Kelvin Umechukwu – Bumpa | Nigeria | Ikoranabuhanga mu bucuruzi. 4. Naom Monari – Bena Care Limited | Kenya | Ubuvuzi. 5. Louisa Gathecha – Bottle Logistics East Africa Ltd | Kenya | Inganda. 6. Samson Fentaye – Thur Biotech Manufacturing Plc | Ethiopia | Ubuhinzi. 7. Jess Roussos – BluLever Education Pty Ltd | Afurika y’Epfo | Uburezi. 8. Joseph Paul – Dawa Mkononi | Tanzania | Ubuvuzi. 9. Gildas Zodome – BIO PHYTO | Benin | Ubuhinzi. 10. Appessika Adanin Laurent Koffi – GREEN AGRO VALLEY CI | Côte d’Ivoire | Ubuhinzi.

Uko umwe mu bageze mu cyiciro cya nyuma abibona

Yagize ati: “Natangiye gusaba kwitabira ABH mu myaka ine ishize, ariko ubu ni bwo bwa mbere nshoboye kurenga icyiciro cyo gutanga ubusabe. Ibyo byanyigishije ko kuba naragiye ntemererwa mu myaka yashize bitaterwaga n’uko ubucuruzi bwanjye butari bwiza, ahubwo ari uko muri Afurika hari ibigo byinshi cyane by’indashyikirwa biri kubakwa.”

Yakomeje avuga ko nubwo yari asanzwe afite uburyo bwo kubara no gukurikirana imari y’ikigo cye, mbere yabubonaga nk’igikoresho gusa abashoramari bakenera.

Ati: “Kunyura mu gice cy’imari mu busabe bwa ABH byatumye nsuzuma byimbitse imikorere y’ubucuruzi bwanjye. Ubu uburyo nkoresha mu micungire y’imari bugaragaza ukwizera mfitiye ibikorwa byanjye ndetse n’amahirwe bifite yo gukura.”

– Naom Monari, umwe mu 10 ba mbere ba ABH 2026, washinze akaba n’Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Bena Care. Ibikorwa bizabanziriza irushanwa rya nyuma i Kigali Mu rwego rwo gutegura irushanwa no kurushaho kumenyekanisha ibikorwa by’abanyemari, mu kwezi k’Ugushyingo hazakorwa ibikorwa bitandukanye bizenguruka mu bice bya Kigali, birimo imurikabikorwa n’ibikorwa byo gusura za kaminuza n'ibigo bifasha ba rwiyemezamirimo kwagura ibikorwa byabo.

Muri ibyo bikorwa harimo na Road to Kigali Running Club, iteganyijwe tariki ya 29 Ugushyingo.

Ibi bizakurikirwa n’inama ihuza ba rwiyemezamirimo 10 bageze mu cyiciro cya nyuma, izaba tariki ya 30 Ugushyingo, ndetse n’inama mpuzamahanga ya ABH Summit & Labs, izaba tariki ya 1 Ukuboza 2026, mu Kigo cy’Inama n’Imurikagurisha cya Kigali (Kigali Convention Centre).

Inkunga yose iteganyijwe gutangwa muri iri rushanwa ingana na miliyoni 1.5 z’amadolari ya Amerika.

Uzatsinda azahabwa ibihumbi 300 by’amadolari, uzaba uwa kabiri ahabwe ibihumbi 250, naho uwa gatatu ahabwe ibihumbi 150.

Abandi barindwi bazasigara bazahabwa ibihumbi 100 by’amadolari buri umwe, mu gihe andi bihumbi 100 azakoreshwa mu mahugurwa yo gufasha ba rwiyemezamirimo kwagura ubumenyi n'ubushobozi ku rwego mpuzamahanga.

Uretse inkunga y'amafaranga, abazitabira iri rushanwa bazabona amahirwe yo kungurana ibitekerezo n’impuguke, guhugurwa, kumenyekanisha ibikorwa byabo ku rwego mpuzamahanga no kwinjira mu muryango wa ABH uhuza ba rwiyemezamirimo, abashoramari, abayobozi b’ibigo n’abajyanama baturutse hirya no hino muri Afurika.

Ibirori bisoza iri rushanwa bizahuza aba 10 bahize abandi, akanama nkemurampaka, abayobozi b’ibigo by’ubucuruzi, abashoramari ndetse n’abandi bafite uruhare mu guteza imbere ishoramari mu Rwanda no muri Afurika.

Aba ba rwiyemezamirimo bazamurikirana ibikorwa byabo imbere y’akanama nkemurampaka kagizwe n’abayobozi bakomeye mu bucuruzi, basaba amahirwe yo kwegukana imwe mu nkunga iteganyijwe.

Akanama nkemurampaka k’uyu mwaka kazaba karimo Dr. Diane Karusisi, Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Banki ya Kigali, na Shola Akinlade, umwe mu bashinze akaba n’Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Paystack. Umuntu wa gatatu uzacyinjiramo azatangazwa nyuma.

Bazareba cyane cyane ubushobozi bw’ibigo mu kwagura ibikorwa, imiyoborere ndetse n’icyerekezo cy’ababiyoboye.

Uwegukana iri rushanwa mu 2026 azatangazwa tariki ya 2 Ukuboza. Abayobozi n’abafatanyabikorwa bakomeye bazitabira inama Uretse irushanwa ryo kumurika ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi, inama ya ABH izahuza abayobozi bashinzwe politiki, abayobozi b’ibigo bikomeye ndetse n’abandi bafite uruhare mu guteza imbere ishoramari n’udushya muri Afurika no hanze yayo.

Mu bazitabira harimo Minisitiri w’Ikoranabuhanga na Inovasiyo mu Rwanda, Paula Ingabire; Umuyobozi Wungirije w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Iterambere (RDB), Juliana Muganza; Umuyobozi Mukuru wa MTN Uganda, Sylvia Mulinge; ndetse n’Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ikigega cy’Igihugu cy’Ibidukikije (Rwanda Green Fund), Teddy Mugabo.

Bazahurira kandi n’abayobozi bakuru bo muri Alibaba Cloud, Ant Group na Alibaba Global Initiatives, abagera kuri 30 bahoze mu 10 ba mbere ba ABH mu bihe byashize, ndetse n’abafatanyabikorwa n’abandi bantu bafite ijambo mu guteza imbere ubucuruzi baturutse mu bihugu 15 bya Afurika.

Abifuza kwitabira ibi birori bisoza irushanwa bashobora kwiyandikisha banyuze ku rubuga rwateganyijwe n’abategura iri rushanwa.

Donald Trump has said he will ban US companies from building AI data centres overseas, threatening a "tremendous tax" for tech firms who do so.

"We're going to keep it all in this country," the US president said, while providing little detail on the potential policy he said others in his cabinet were hearing about for the first time.

Data centres were a central issue in the midterm elections earlier in November, with many Democratic candidates promising tougher regulation on their construction.

Tech giants including Meta and Google have entered agreements to build data centres overseas. It remains unclear how such a policy would be enforced if it was brought in.

"We're not going to allow our companies to build data centres outside of our country," Trump told reporters in a press briefing following his return from his trip to Asia.

"Because China will take all of them, and we're not allowing that to happen."

But whether that idea will become policy remains unclear.

"I don't know if that's a breaking story, but I haven't even said that to my people. But I'm telling them now, they're here," he said.

Trump floated the policy after saying the US was leading on data centre construction, and he would not allow China to beat the US when it came to AI - which he calls super intelligence, or SI.

Data centres are crucial to the AI boom. The vast warehouse-style buildings house the advanced computer chips and servers that are needed to run AI programmes such as Claude and ChatGPT.

As of April there were about 3,000 data centres across the US, with another 1,500 in various stages of approval and construction, according to the Pew Research Centre.

Many of them are built in rural areas, and concerns about issues including noise pollution and energy consumption helped drive Democratic candidates promising tougher rules on data centre construction to wins on 3 November.

"You ought to take advantage of the the data centres. Make them pay you, make them pay your community, but take advantage don't shut them off," Trump said.

"We have a lot of places that want them badly, and they're great places. They have energy and they have everything. They're tremendous assets."

Canada has made moves to step in to offer itself as an alternative location for these sites, with less local pushback against projects so far.

Large tech firms - often called AI hyperscalers due to the size of their investments in AI - have also been branching out.

In September Google announced a €13bn ($15bn: £11bn) investment in AI infrastructure in Finland, which included funding for three data centres.

Last month, building work for two of those centres was halted due to concerns over the clearance of more than 300 hectares of forest.

Trump called out the build in Finland specifically, saying his administration was "not allowing that to happen".

Michel Houellebecq (left) and (right) Gérard Depardieu have been accused of an on-set incident

Warning: this story contains graphic content

French authorities are investigating disgraced actor Gérard Depardieu and the author Michel Houellebecq over "allegations of a sexual nature", a source with knowledge of the investigation says.

The confirmation comes after reports in French media that the two were accused of being involved in a "gang rape" on the set of the film Thalasso in 2018 by an actress.

The source told the BBC that a judicial investigation was launched after a complaint was filed in May 2025.

Depardieu has already separately been convicted of unrelated sexual assaults. The BBC has contacted Depardieu's lawyers and Houellebecq, an acclaimed French author and occasional actor, for comment.

The actress, who has not been named publicly, accused Depardieu of penetration without consent and Houellebecq of forcing her to perform oral sex, in an interview with Mediapart, a French investigative site which first reported the allegations.

She told the outlet that none of this had been written into the script, and that she experienced "profound humiliation" and "unspeakable shame".

French law stipulates as of 2025 that all sexual acts performed without consent constitute rape.

The film's director, Guillaume Nicloux, has been accused of being complicit because he was said to have filmed the incident, Mediapart and AFP report. The BBC has contacted his agent and the Paris prosecutor's office for comment.

Nicloux told Mediapart that the scene had been improvised and he had not intervened as he had not observed "any constraints, verbal or physical opposition, or even discomfort".

The site published production documents showing footage of the scene had been destroyed.

The actress told the outlet that she had told friends, her agent and others involved in the film's production in Normandy about the incident at the time, but only filed the complaint after other women accused Depardieu of sexual misconduct.

The Asterix and Obelix star will next week find out whether he will stand trial for allegedly raping another actress, Charlotte Arnould.

On Monday, Depardieu dropped his appeal against a separate conviction for two counts of sexual assault during another film shoot, for which he was handed an 18-month suspended sentence.

Several other women have made allegations against the 77-year-old in the media.
